lock_timing: before SynthStroke pilot inference and before any SynthStroke formal outcome scoring
rationale: Add one contemporary model from a different implementation and training family to address the single-family limitation without changing the two prespecified primary upgrade comparisons.

model.publication: Chalcroft et al., Synthetic Data for Robust Stroke Segmentation, Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging, 2025, doi:10.59275/j.melba.2025-f3g6
model.architecture: MONAI 3D U-Net with six output classes
model.training: mixed synthetic images derived from OASIS-3 tissue maps and ATLAS R2 lesion masks plus real ATLAS R2 training images
model.formal_training_evaluation_overlap: zero at the 655-case ATLAS R2 resource level versus the fixed 762-case formal evaluation cohort, established by the frozen identifier audit

execution.preprocessing: published inference path: RAS orientation, 1-mm isotropic spacing, histogram normalization, whole-volume intensity normalization, inverse transformation to native array shape
execution.binary_prediction_rule: argmax across six native-space class probabilities equals stroke class 5

analysis_role.reported_endpoints: the same descriptive metrics, source-stratified center-macro lesion-wise F1, source gap, calibration, and uncertainty summaries as the locked model family
analysis_role.permitted_claim: descriptive same-cohort contrast under different preprocessing and training design

stop_rules: stop before scoring if the three-case outcome-blinded pilot cannot restore exact native array shape
stop before scoring if model or configuration hashes drift
stop before scoring if any formal case fails to produce nonempty NIfTI, NPZ, and PKL outputs
do not tune probability thresholds, preprocessing, TTA, postprocessing, or case subsets after formal outcomes are opened
report null or adverse performance without removing the model
